facts.fact: Téla Nón reports the ANPDP president, José Manuel Costa Alegre, met the National Assembly president to plan the agency's oversight of personal data in the automatic electoral roll, and describes the agency as the body that by law authorises and supervises all data processing; the meeting was the Tuesday before publication (published 15 April 2026).
